meta.title: Supplementary Material — Group-conformal calibration of near-infrared prediction intervals for new seasons, instruments and regions using PLS diagnostics
abstract: Supplementary tables S1–S15 and figures S1–S2. All values are generated from the result files of the accompanying code (run_all.py).

rows: {mango: Savitzky-Golay 2nd derivative, window 13, poly 2, wavelengths 684-990 nm, ossl: log10(1/R) at 10 nm steps 400-2500 nm, Savitzky-Golay 1st derivative, window 11; target log(1+OC), corn: SNV then Savitzky-Golay 1st derivative, window 15, tablets: SNV then Savitzky-Golay 1st derivative, window 15}
{A_max: {mango: 20, ossl: 25, corn: 15, tablets: 15}, selection: min group-balanced RMSE of out-of-group cross-validation}
{features: [log(1+T2), log(Q/Q_ref)], link: log, loss: Poisson quasi-likelihood, floor_frac: 0.1}
{density_ratio: logistic regression on standardised PLS scores and log Q, max_n_per_class: 20000}

{architecture: Conv1d(1->8, kernel 9, same padding) - ELU - Flatten - Linear(64) - ELU - Linear(32) - ELU - Linear(1), inputs: per-wavelength standardised (training statistics), optimizer: Adam lr 1e-3, weight decay 1e-4, batch 256, epochs: max 40, early stopping patience 8 on a 10 % unit-grouped internal validation split, device: auto (CPU/CUDA/MPS)}
{weights: density ratios normalised to mean 1 on the calibration set and capped at 20}
